span.normalized: Sales to our customers constituting more than 10% of our net revenue represented, in the aggregate, 45%, 57% and 58% of our net revenue in 2023, 2024 and 2025, respectively. Our customers constituting more than 10% of our net revenue were (i) Micron, SK Hynix and AFASTOR in 2023, (ii) Micron, Kioxia, PHISEMI and AFASTOR in 2024 and (iii) PHISEMI, Kioxia, AFASTOR, and Micron in 2025. The identities of our largest customers and their respective contributions to our net revenue may vary from period to period.
